title: dendrorkis rufinula
intro: Dendrorkis rufinula, commonly known as the red beech tree, is a type of plant species in the family Fagaceae. The health benefits of Dendrorkis rufinula include its ability to support cardiovascular health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties.
